items.title: Cloudflare Introduces Meerkat for Strongly Consistent Global Coordination
items.summary: Cloudflare recently introduced Meerkat, an internal globally consistent control-plane service based on the QuePaxa consensus algorithm. Unlike Raft, it allows leaderless writes while preserving strong consistency, improving availability across Cloudflare's global network. By Renato Losio

items.title: AWS Introduces Free Sandbox Environments for Workshops
items.summary: AWS Builder Center now offers free, time-limited sandbox environments for workshops, so developers no longer need to use their own AWS account and credit card or worry about unexpected charges. This has been a long-standing request from the community and removes one of the biggest friction points for practitioners learning new AWS technologies. By Renato Losio

items.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
items.summary: OpenAI shares new results on long-standing open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, including advances in geometry, cryptography, and complexity.
